A named commit tells one fixed version of the change.

Review frame: source:commit · scope: `agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src` · current version: commit `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`

The commit is bound by its full commit ID. For a pull request, the story follows the current branch comparison instead: source:pr, PR #42, base `main` at `aaaaaaaa`, and head `feature/login` at `bbbbbbbb`. Recheck those identities before each step. If the base or head changes, rebuild the story.

The two source identities stay separate: the commit uses one full ID, while the pull request uses its current base and head.
